sprint.name: Quick Prototype Sprint
sprint.description: Prototype structure for nextjs + fastify + postgresql MVP focused on auth, vault key management, routing, and audit chain.

project.name: ProjexCloud
project.description: The single canonical architecture: a shared horizontal platform — services, agents, contracts, design system, native SDK ecosystem (HDK), and the AIM (Application & Identity Management) foundation — consumed by every vertical we build. Builds once. Multi-tenant. Multi-vertical. Multi-app. Multi-surface (web · mobile · kiosk). Petabyte-scale via pool-based horizontal scaling (no sharding). Identity expressed as a six-layer stack — Master Person · App Identity · Tenant Membership · Persona · Encounter · Relationship — encrypted end-to-end and governed by a three-evaluator access mesh.

epics.title: Vault & Secrets SDK
epics.description: Typed KMS facade, 7-tier key hierarchy, envelope encryption helpers, and secret lifecycle ops for the MVP.

epics.title: Core MVP: Authentication, Pool Routing & Event Contracts
epics.description: Provides user identity, tenant/app pool routing, event envelope handling, and an emit-only meter gate to enable end-to-end user flows for the MVP.

epics.title: Audit & Telemetry
epics.description: Append-only audit ledger, tamper-evident hash chain, and a universal emit-only meter gate for basic telemetry.

features.title: 7-Tier Key Hierarchy
features.description: Implement the canonical 7-tier key hierarchy and cryptographic shred operations.
features.acceptance_criteria: ["Key tiers can be created and linked","Shred renders keys unrecoverable","Key metadata persisted"]

features.title: Append-only Audit Chain
features.description: Immutable ledger for events with hash chaining.
features.acceptance_criteria: ["Appends create new ledger rows","Each row contains hash linking to previous","Ledger rows are immutable via API"]

features.title: User Registration & Authentication
features.description: Sign-up, login, JWT sessions, password hashing, and canonical identity mapping.
features.acceptance_criteria: ["Users can register with email and password","Registered users can log in and receive a JWT","Password stored hashed and salted"]
